aviato_findings.title: Generic or non-descriptive alt / aria-label values on content images
aviato_findings.explanation: axe-core passes any non-empty alt string, even generic placeholders like alt="image" or alt="product-img". Screen-reader shoppers hear repetitive role words instead of product details.

aviato_findings.title: CSS removes :focus outline (outline: 0 / none) without a visible focus indicator
examples: css/style.css: a, a:focus, a:hover { text-decoration: none; outline: 0; color: #000; }
aviato_findings.explanation: Static axe-core DOM checks do not fail stylesheets that strip :focus outlines, leaving keyboard-only users unable to see where focus is on the page.

aviato_findings.title: Form controls relying on placeholder text without a persistent <label>
examples: index.html: <input type="text" placeholder="Enter Your Email Address"> (no <label>)
aviato_findings.explanation: Placeholders vanish as soon as a user types and often have low contrast; every input needs an explicit <label> or persistent accessible name.

diagnosis.headline: The template suffers from widespread color‑contrast failures and missing accessible names, compounded by CSS that hides focus indicators.

shared_root_causes.title: Insufficient color contrast in UI elements
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Adjust foreground/background colors to meet WCAG AA contrast ratios (≥4.5:1 normal text, ≥3:1 large text) and verify with a contrast checker.

shared_root_causes.title: Missing or non-descriptive accessible names for images, links, and form controls
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: 77 link-name, 2 image-alt, 1 label violations; plus Placebo flags 11 generic alt/aria-label and 7 placeholder-only form controls
shared_root_causes.soundcheck_catch: Placeholder-only form controls and generic alt/aria-label (Placebo findings)
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Provide meaningful alt text that describes the image content; ensure link text is descriptive or use aria-label; associate every form control with a <label> element (or aria-label/aria-labelledby); stop relying solely on placeholder text for naming.

shared_root_causes.title: CSS removes :focus outline without providing a visible focus indicator
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: Not captured by axe-core; leaves keyboard users unable to see focus position
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Retain a visible focus indicator (e.g., outline: 2px solid #000 or use :focus-visible) or supply alternative styling that meets contrast requirements when focused.

diagnosis.why_axe_alone_is_not_enough: Axe-core only evaluates static DOM and style rules, so it misses issues that depend on dynamic behavior or insufficient visual cues, such as generic alt text, missing labels, and removed focus outlines. The three Placebo findings expose these gaps: generic/non‑descriptive alt/aria‑label values, reliance on placeholder text without persistent labels, and CSS that strips :focus outlines without a visible indicator.
